optimizationRules: Do not infer a public URL until independently verified.
Do not reduce price merely to increase item count; account for fixed per-order fees.
Prefer complementary bundles when they increase expected average order value and solve a coherent buyer problem.
Use actual sales and message data when available; otherwise state that evidence is still sparse.
Use sales thresholds as signals, not hard gates; strong external demand evidence can justify earlier bundle, license, localization, or funnel work.
Do not reactivate KDP or LINE without explicit user instruction.
Do not impose arbitrary weekly, daily, or per-run production caps. Increase output when quality, demand, originality, and policy compliance are maintained.
If a new-product idea is weak, switch to a stronger idea or materially improve an existing funnel rather than ending without a concrete deliverable.
